content.title: Is Dominic Fike in 'Euphoria' season 3? Florida native played 'Elliot'
content.text: April 12, 2026, 1:14 p.m. ET"Euphoria" season 3 is set to premiere on Sunday, April 12, at 9 p.m. ET on HBO and HBO Max.Dominic Fike will return as Elliot, and many original cast members like Zendaya and Sydney Sweeney are also confirmed.New cast members include Rosalía, Marshawn Lynch, Trisha Paytas, and Natasha Lyonne.Barbie Ferreira, Austin Abrams, Algee Smith, and Storm Reid will not be returning for the new season.The season will consist of eight episodes, airing weekly through May 31.Dominic Fike is set to return as "Elliot" in season three of the HBO hit show "Euphoria," premiering Sunday, April 12, over four years after the release of season two.The Naples, Florida native is reprising his role alongside returning cast members Zendaya, Hunter Schafer, Jacob Elordi, Alexa Demie and more, Variety exclusively reported in February 2025.The popular television drama welcomes new cast members this season played by some big names in music, sports and social media. And missing from the cast are some notable original characters.Season three drops viewers off five years after the events of season two, with the controversial characters now out of high school.Here's what to know ahead of the premiere.What time does 'Euphoria' come out today?"Euphoria" season three premieres Sunday, April 12 at 9 p.m. ET. New episodes will drop weekly through May 31.Where can I watch 'Euphoria' season 3?Fans can watch season three of "Euphoria" on HBO and via streaming on HBO Max.Watch Euphoria on HBO MaxIs Dominic Fike in 'Euphoria' season 3?In February 2025, Variety exclusively reported that Naples native and Grammy-nominated artist Dominic Fike will reprise his role as "Elliot" in season three of "Euphoria."In the second season, Elliot was caught up in a love triangle with Rue and Jules, played by Zendaya and Hunter Schafer. Fike later went on to date Schafer for about a year in real life.Fike wore a “Naples” T-shirt in one scene during Season 2, Episode 2 to represent his Florida hometown.'Euphoria' season 3 castAccording to Variety, the cast members returning to "Euphoria" for season three of the HBO hit drama include:Zendaya (Rue Bennett)Hunter Schafer (Jules Vaughn)Jacob Elordi (Nate Jacobs)Sydney Sweeney (Cassie Howard)Alexa Demie (Maddy Perez)Maude Apatow (Lexie Howard)Eric Dane (Cal Jacobs)Dane died at 53 years old on Feb. 19 following a battle with ALS.Martha Kelly (Laurie)Chloe Cherry (Faye)Colman Domingo (Ali Muhammed)Dominic Fike (Elliot)Newcomers consist of Grammy-winning artist Rosalía, former NFL player and Super Bowl champion Marshawn Lynch, Trisha Paytas, Natasha Lyonne, Danielle Deadwyler and more.'Euphoria' cast members not returning for season 3Here are the original "Euphoria" cast members who are not returning for season three, according to Variety:Barbie Ferreira (Kat Hernandez)Austin Abrams (Ethan)Algee Smith (Christopher McKay)Storm Reid (Gia Bennett)Angus Cloud (Fezco)Cloud died at age 25 in July 2023. In an interview with Variety, creator Sam Levinson says the show keeps Cloud's character alive with scenes where characters speak to Fez over the phone.How many episodes of 'Euphoria' season 3 will there be?Season three of "Euphoria" consists of eight episodes, premiering Sunday, April 12.Contributing: Charles Runnells, Fort Myers News-Press & Naples Daily News
